reference.title: Flow logging for network security groups (NSG flow logs overview) - Azure Network Watcher, log format Version 2

delivery.partitioning: resourceId=/SUBSCRIPTIONS/{subscriptionID}/RESOURCEGROUPS/{resourceGroupName}/PROVIDERS/MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/{nsgName}/ then y=/m=/d=/h= then literal m=00 (minute component is fixed) then macAddress={macAddress}
delivery.cadence: PT1H (one blob per hour per MAC address); logs collected at 1-minute intervals

notes: NSG flow logs retire on 2027-09-30 and no longer support creation of new NSG flow logs; existing records in Storage keep following their retention policy.
The minute path component is literally m=00, not a minute value.
flowTuples is a comma-separated string; only the 13 position semantics are documented, not JSON sub-fields.
No manifest or metadata file is documented for this surface.
Compression and encoding are not documented.

Os 13 membros JSON do registo tem type derivado do exemplo oficial (sample Version 2) com type_source=format-observed e type_note citando o trecho; as 13 posicoes do CSV flowTuples (26 colunas com as duas grafias de conjunto) continuam sem tipo porque o payload as entrega dentro de uma string.

unverified.name: delivery.compression
unverified.reason: No official page consulted states a compression algorithm (or its absence) for PT1H.json. Field intentionally left empty.

unverified.name: delivery.encoding
unverified.reason: No official page consulted states the character encoding.

unverified.name: flowTuples counter values for flow state B
unverified.reason: Docs state 'Statistics aren't provided' for B and the official examples show empty fields; no numeric value or literal placeholder is documented.

unverified.name: records[].time fractional-second digit count
unverified.reason: All official examples show exactly 7 fractional digits, but the documentation does not assert that the count is fixed.

unverified.name: manifest / metadata blob
unverified.reason: No manifest or metadata file is documented for NSG flow logs v2.

unverified.name: records[].resourceid (all-lowercase spelling)
unverified.reason: Appears in the property list of the official page while every official JSON example uses 'resourceId'. Both spellings exist in the same official document; no inference taken about which is authoritative.

unverified.name: maximum PT1H.json size / maximum record count
